channel.title: AI Threat Watch: TR
channel.description: Verified case files located in TR.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Turkish police jail university entrance exam candidate who used a button camera and AI to get answers
item.description: During Turkey's university entrance exam in Isparta, a candidate used a camera disguised as a shirt button, a router hidden in his shoe sole and an earpiece; the camera captured questions and AI software generated answers read back to him. He was detained for acting suspiciously, formally arrested and jailed pending trial, and an accomplice was also detained. Target: Turkey's national university entrance exam (Isparta province). TR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Turkey's 'Yapay Zeka-2' operation: 16 held for deepfake ads imitating officials' voices
item.description: Osmaniye-centred raids in nine provinces detained 16 suspects, 11 jailed, for fake investment ads reproducing voices and footage of senior Turkish officials with AI; Istanbul later warned of ads using Imamoglu's image. Target: Turkish social media users. TR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Turkish police jail five over 410M lira investment scam using deepfakes of officials
item.description: An Osmaniye-based police operation detained eight suspects, five later jailed, for promoting fake investments on social media with AI images and voices of Turkish officials; losses put at 410 million lira (about $9.5M). Target: Turkish social media users. TR. Verification: confirmed.
